name: Small tournaments in which every four vertices have a common dominator (Schütte's problem, k = 4)
description: construct() -> {'n': n, 'orientation': [...]}: one bit per pair (i,j), i<j, of vertices 0..n-1 in lexicographic order (0 means i -> j, 1 means j -> i), 5 <= n <= 90. Every set of 4 vertices must have a vertex with arcs to all four. Minimize n. A valid tournament on n vertices certifies f(4) <= n. The smallest known has 67 vertices; Erdős's lower bound gives f(4) >= 31.
